features_used.evidence: In addition to basic network attributes such as timestamp, source and destination IP addresses, protocol information, and packet length, the dataset also includes JA4-based TLS fingerprint attributes [55].

feature_groups.evidence: Extracting JA4-based features makes it possible to detect anomalous behavior effectively even within encrypted Transport Layer Security (TLS) traffic.

fingerprints_used.evidence: JA4 fingerprint extraction was used as input data for DL models, and high-accuracy attack detection was performed.

model_family.evidence: The proposed method is predicated on a DL-based architecture called CNN-LSTM, and the classification performance of this architecture has been evaluated by comparing it with seven different traditional ML algorithms.
